inductive Event : Type 1 where
  | returned {A : Type} : Call A → A → Event
abbrev Log := List Event
inductive Code (A : Type) : Type 1 where
  | done : A → Code A
  | step {B : Type} : Result B → (B → Code A) → Code A
  | call {B : Type} : Call B → (B → Code A) → Code A

def bind {A B : Type} : Code A → (A → Code B) → Code B
  | .done a, k => k a
  | .step r c, k => .step r (fun b => bind (c b) k)
  | .call op c, k => .call op (fun b => bind (c b) k)
instance : Monad Code where
  pure := Code.done
  bind := bind

def liftResult {A : Type} (r : Result A) : Code A := .step r .done
instance : MonadLift Result Code where
  monadLift := liftResult

def perform {A : Type} (op : Call A) : Code A := .call op .done

def erase (ops : VTop_Stages.Ops) {A : Type} : Code A → Result A
  | .done a => ok a
  | .step r k => do let b ← r; erase ops (k b)
  | .call op k => do let b ← invoke ops op; erase ops (k b)

def thenResult {A : Type u} {B : Type v} (r : Result A) (k : A → Result B) : Result B :=
  match r with
  | .ok a => k a
  | .fail e => .fail e
  | .div => .div

def forget {A : Type} (r : Result (A × Log)) : Result A :=
  thenResult r (fun x => ok x.1)

def run (ops : VTop_Stages.Ops) {A : Type} : Code A → Log → Result (A × Log)
  | .done a, log => ok (a,log)
  | .step r k, log => thenResult r (fun b => run ops (k b) log)
  | .call op k, log => thenResult (invoke ops op) (fun b =>
      run ops (k b) (log ++ [.returned op b]))

theorem erase_run (ops : VTop_Stages.Ops) {A : Type} (p : Code A) (log : Log) :
    forget (run ops p log) = erase ops p := by
  induction p generalizing log with
  | done a => rfl
  | step r k ih =>
    cases r with
    | fail e => rfl
    | div => rfl
    | ok b => exact ih b log
  | call op k ih =>
    cases h : invoke ops op with
    | fail e => simp only [run,thenResult,forget,erase,h,bind_tc_fail]
    | div => simp only [run,thenResult,forget,erase,h,bind_tc_div]
    | ok b => simpa only [run,thenResult,erase,h,bind_tc_ok] using ih b (log ++ [.returned op b])

theorem run_prefix (ops : VTop_Stages.Ops) {A : Type} (p : Code A)
    (before after : Log) (a : A) (success : run ops p before = ok (a,after)) :
    ∃ suffix, after = before ++ suffix := by
  induction p generalizing before after with
  | done b =>
    have eq := Result.ok.inj success
    exact ⟨[], by simpa using congrArg Prod.snd eq.symm⟩
  | step r k ih =>
    cases r with
    | fail e => cases success
    | div => cases success
    | ok b => exact ih b before after success
  | call op k ih =>
    cases h : invoke ops op with
    | fail e => simp only [run,thenResult,h]  at success; cases success
    | div => simp only [run,thenResult,h]  at success; cases success
    | ok b =>
      simp only [run,thenResult,h] at success
      obtain ⟨suffix,hs⟩ := ih b _ after success
      exact ⟨.returned op b :: suffix, by simpa only [List.append_assoc,List.singleton_append] using hs⟩

theorem erase_perform (ops : VTop_Stages.Ops) {A : Type} (op : Call A) :
    erase ops (perform op) = invoke ops op := by
  cases h : invoke ops op <;> simp only [perform,erase,h,bind_tc_ok,bind_tc_fail,bind_tc_div]

theorem erase_lift (ops : VTop_Stages.Ops) {A : Type} (r : Result A) :
    erase ops (liftResult r) = r := by cases r <;> rfl

theorem erase_bind (ops : VTop_Stages.Ops) {A B : Type} (p : Code A) (k : A → Code B) :
    erase ops (p >>= k) = (do let a ← erase ops p; erase ops (k a)) := by
  induction p with
  | done a => rfl
  | step r c ih =>
    change (do let b ← r; erase ops (bind (c b) k)) = _
    have h : ∀ b, erase ops (bind (c b) k) =
      (do let a ← erase ops (c b); erase ops (k a)) := ih
    simp only [h,erase]
    cases r <;> rfl
  | call op c ih =>
    change (do let b ← invoke ops op; erase ops (bind (c b) k)) = _
    have h : ∀ b, erase ops (bind (c b) k) =
      (do let a ← erase ops (c b); erase ops (k a)) := ih
    simp only [h,erase]
    cases invoke ops op <;> rfl

#print axioms run_prefix
#print axioms erase_perform
#print axioms erase_lift
#print axioms erase_bind

/-! Oracle interpretation of the extracted typed call tree. All call arguments
and returned mutable state are retained. No identification with dV is assumed
or claimed. Ordinary inner Rust Err is a value of the dependent result type. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.VTop_OracleCode
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result VTop_Trace
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep
open AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw AspisV8R19.OracleProgramOps

abbrev Implementation := {A : Type} → Call A → Program Bytes State (Result A)

def continueWith {A B : Type} (r : Result A)
    (k : A → Program Bytes State (Result B)) : Program Bytes State (Result B) :=
  match r with
  | .ok a => k a
  | .fail e => .done (.fail e)
  | .div => .done .div

def interpret (impl : Implementation) {A : Type} : Code A → Program Bytes State (Result A)
  | .done a => .done (.ok a)
  | .step r k => continueWith r (fun a => interpret impl (k a))
  | .call op k => bind (impl op) (fun r => continueWith r (fun a => interpret impl (k a)))

/-- A local call law: complete ordered reads and the complete dependent return
are equal whenever that source call returns. This does not bind an arbitrary
Verifier to the tree, and does not identify a model implementation with dV. -/
def CallJoin (source model : Implementation) : Prop :=
  ∀ {A : Type} (call : Call A) (H : Bytes → State) (value : A),
    (eval H (source call)).2 = .ok value →
      eval H (source call) = eval H (model call)

/-- Symbolic substitution through the actual typed syntax, retaining source
branch selection and concatenation order. No large stage reduction is needed. -/
theorem accepted_interpret_eq (source model : Implementation) (joins : CallJoin source model)
    {A : Type} (tree : Code A) (H : Bytes → State) (value : A)
    (accepted : (eval H (interpret source tree)).2 = .ok value) :
    eval H (interpret source tree) = eval H (interpret model tree) := by
  induction tree with
  | done a => rfl
  | step r k ih =>
    cases r with
    | fail e => cases accepted
    | div => cases accepted
    | ok a => exact ih a accepted
  | call op k ih =>
    simp only [interpret, eval_bind] at accepted ⊢
    cases returned : (eval H (source op)).2 with
    | fail e => simp only [returned, continueWith, eval] at accepted; cases accepted
    | div => simp only [returned, continueWith, eval] at accepted; cases accepted
    | ok a =>
      have localJoin := joins op H a returned
      rw [← localJoin]
      simp only [returned, continueWith] at accepted ⊢
      rw [ih a accepted]

#print axioms accepted_interpret_eq
end AspisR1.VTop_OracleCode
end

def LocalBudgets (rest : Implementation) (w : Nat → Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ {A : Type} (op : Call A) (H : Bytes → State),
    operationId op ∈ delegatedIds → (eval H (rest op)).1.length ≤ w (operationId op)

theorem delegated (ops : Ops) (reserved : Bool) (unwrap : Port6CK_Semantic.Unwrap)
    (rest : Implementation) (w : Nat → Nat) (budgets : LocalBudgets rest w)
    {A : Type} (op : Call A) (H : Bytes → State)
    (member : operationId op ∈ delegatedIds) :
    (eval H (Port9OR_Installed.implementation ops reserved unwrap rest op)).1.length ≤ w (operationId op) := by
  have same : Port9OR_Installed.implementation ops reserved unwrap rest op = rest op := by
    cases op <;> simp_all only [operationId, delegatedIds, List.mem_cons,
      List.not_mem_nil, or_false, Nat.reduceEqDiff, or_self]
    all_goals rfl
  rw [same]
  exact budgets op H member

theorem library (ops : Ops) (reserved : Bool) (unwrap : Port6CK_Semantic.Unwrap)
    (rest : Implementation) {A : Type} (op : Call A) (H : Bytes → State)
    (member : operationId op ∈ VTop_OracleStages.libraryIds) :
    (eval H (Port9OR_Installed.implementation ops reserved unwrap rest op)).1.length ≤ 0 := by
  rw [Port9OR_Installed.implementation, Port9OR_Bodies.implementation,

def map4 (a : Array U64 4#usize) : Result (Array U32 4#usize) := do
  let x0 ← Array.index_usize a 0#usize
  let y0 ← S8Kani2MutableExtraction.aspis_core.field.M31.reduce_u64 x0
  let x1 ← Array.index_usize a 1#usize
  let y1 ← S8Kani2MutableExtraction.aspis_core.field.M31.reduce_u64 x1
  let x2 ← Array.index_usize a 2#usize
  let y2 ← S8Kani2MutableExtraction.aspis_core.field.M31.reduce_u64 x2
  let x3 ← Array.index_usize a 3#usize
  let y3 ← S8Kani2MutableExtraction.aspis_core.field.M31.reduce_u64 x3
  ok (Array.make 4#usize [y0,y1,y2,y3])
def native (map : Array U64 4#usize → Result (Array U32 4#usize))
  (self : verifier.BatchedWeights) (index : Std.Usize) :
  Result aspis_core.field.QM31
  := do
  let a ←
    alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice (Array Std.U64
      4#usize)) self.«raw» index
  let a1 ←
    map a
  let a2 ← Array.index_usize a1 0#usize
  let b ← Array.index_usize a1 1#usize
  let c ← Array.index_usize a1 2#usize
  let d ← Array.index_usize a1 3#usize
  ok { c0 := { a := a2, b }, c1 := { a := c, b := d } }

  funext b i

/-- Pointwise S5 value-child agreement is needed only at reached row indices;
no whole-operation equality or raw bound is a hypothesis. -/
theorem lower_value (nativeValue : verifier.BatchedWeights → Usize → Result K)
    (b : verifier.BatchedWeights) (old : Slice K)
    (lengths : old.val.length ≤ b.raw.val.length)
    (S5_value : ∀ i : Usize, i.val < old.val.length → nativeValue b i = value b i) :
    Port3_NativeFlushBody.verifier.BatchedWeights.finish std nativeValue b old =
      Port3_FlushInstall.flush b old := by
  let f := fun j => Port3_FlushInstall.fromMutable (S8Kani2MutableValue.valueAt ⟨b.raw,b.terms⟩ j)
  have values : ∀ i : Usize, i.val < old.val.length → value b i = ok (f i.val) := by
    intro i hi
    unfold value
    rw [S8Kani2MutableValue.valueAt_success ⟨b.raw,b.terms⟩ i (by change i.val < b.raw.val.length; omega)]
    rfl
  rw [finish_total b nativeValue old f (by intro i hi; exact (S5_value i hi).trans (values i hi))]
  rw [← reference_eq b old lengths,finish_total b value old f values]

theorem accepted_rows (b : verifier.BatchedWeights) (old out : Slice K)
    (lengths : old.val.length ≤ b.raw.val.length) (success : flush b old = ok out) :
    out.val = (b.raw.val.take old.val.length).map (fun row =>
      Port3_FlushInstall.fromMutable (S8Kani2FinishReferenceJoin.toFinish (S8OwnedP6Finish.modelValue row))) ∧
    out.val.length = old.val.length ∧
    ∀ q ∈ out.val, Port3_FlushInstall.Canonical q := by
  have h : Port3_FlushInstall.flush b old = ok out := (reference_eq b old lengths).symm.trans success
  exact ⟨(Port3_FlushInstall.accepted_contents b old out lengths h).1,
    (Port3_FlushInstall.accepted_contents b old out lengths h).2,
    Port3_FlushInstall.accepted_canonical b old out lengths h⟩

def field (q : K) : AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact :=
  S8JoinFinishField.fieldValue (Port3_FlushInstall.toOwned q)

theorem row_field (row : S8OwnedP6ValueModel.Row) :
    field (Port3_FlushInstall.fromMutable (S8Kani2FinishReferenceJoin.toFinish (S8OwnedP6Finish.modelValue row))) =
      S8JoinFinishField.rawValue row := S8JoinFinishField.modelValue_field row

/-- Native finish preserves precisely the exact field value of every raw row;
canonicalization is allowed and no raw phase bound is required. -/
theorem accepted_field (b : verifier.BatchedWeights) (old out : Slice K)
    (lengths : old.val.length ≤ b.raw.val.length) (success : flush b old = ok out) :
    out.val.map field = (b.raw.val.take old.val.length).map S8JoinFinishField.rawValue := by
  rw [(accepted_rows b old out lengths success).1,List.map_map]
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro row _
  exact row_field row

/-- Candidate replaces only the actual returned accumulator's weights. -/
def materialize (a : verifier.Accumulator) (out : Slice K) : verifier.Accumulator :=
  {a with weights := ⟨out.val,out.property⟩}

theorem materialize_fields (a : verifier.Accumulator) (out : Slice K) :
    (materialize a out).rhs = a.rhs ∧ (materialize a out).power = a.power ∧
    (materialize a out).next = a.next ∧ (materialize a out).weights.val = out.val :=
  ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl,rfl⟩

def core.result.Result.map_err {T E F O : Type}
    (inst : core.ops.function.FnOnce O E F) (self : core.result.Result T E) (op : O) :
    Result (core.result.Result T F) := do
  match self with
  | .Ok t => ok (.Ok t)
  | .Err e =>

    ok (.Err t)

  finalLen : transport.Variant → Result Usize
  zero : Result KRaw
  copy : core.marker.Copy KRaw
  filled : core.marker.Copy KRaw → Usize → KRaw →
    Result (core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec KRaw) AllocError)
  zeroWide : Result ERaw
  one : Result KRaw

  ⟨fun _ _ => ok (.Allocation)⟩

/-- Exact emitted instruction order, including map_err/branch/residual. -/
def extracted {AllocError : Type} (ops : Leaves AllocError) (v : transport.Variant) :
    Result (core.result.Result verifier.Accumulator verifier.Error) := do
  let i ← ops.finalLen v
  let q ← ops.zero
  let r ← ops.filled ops.copy i q
  let r1 ← core.result.Result.map_err allocationError r ()
  let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r1
  match cf with
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
    let we ← ops.zeroWide
    let q1 ← ops.one
    ok (.Ok {weights := val, rhs := we, power := q1, next := 0#usize})
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
      verifier.Accumulator (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error) residual

    core.result.Result.map_err allocationError r () = Port3_Initial.mapFilled r := by
  cases r <;> rfl

    extracted ops v = Port3_Initial.emitted ops.finalLen ops.zero (ops.filled ops.copy)
      ops.zeroWide ops.one v := by

  rfl

namespace AspisR1.Port3_Initial

def mapFilled {AllocError : Type}
    (r : core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec KRaw) AllocError) :
    Result (core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec KRaw) verifier.Error) :=
  match r with | .Ok v => ok (.Ok v) | .Err _ => ok (.Err .Allocation)

/-- Parameterized emitted body, retaining map_err, Try and residual control. -/
def emitted {AllocError : Type}
    (finalLen : transport.Variant → Result Usize) (zero : Result KRaw)
    (filled : Usize → KRaw → Result (core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec KRaw) AllocError))
    (zeroWide : Result ERaw) (one : Result KRaw) (v : transport.Variant) :
    Result (core.result.Result verifier.Accumulator verifier.Error) := do
  let i ← finalLen v
  let q ← zero
  let r ← filled i q
  let r1 ← mapFilled r
  let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r1
  match cf with
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue weights => do
    let rhs ← zeroWide
    let power ← one
    ok (.Ok ⟨weights,rhs,power,0#usize⟩)
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
      verifier.Accumulator (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error) residual

def constructor (reserved : Bool) : transport.Variant →
    Result (core.result.Result verifier.Accumulator verifier.Error) :=
  emitted CheckpointBytes4Ops.finalLen (ok zeroK)
    (CheckpointBytes3Allocation.filled reserved) (ok zeroE) (ok oneK)

/-- Exact whole Result at S2: no success-only equation is used here. -/
theorem constructor_shell (reserved : Bool) :
    constructor reserved .S2 = newS2 (CheckpointBytes3Allocation.filled reserved 64#usize zeroK) := by
  unfold constructor emitted CheckpointBytes4Ops.finalLen
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  cases CheckpointBytes3Allocation.filled reserved 64#usize zeroK with
  | fail e => rfl
  | div => rfl
  | ok r => cases r <;> rfl

def install (base : Ops) (reserved : Bool) : Ops :=
  {Port3_CheckpointInstall.install base reserved with op12 := constructor reserved}

theorem accepted_fields (base : Ops) (reserved : Bool) (a : verifier.Accumulator)
    (accepted : (install base reserved).op12 .S2 = ok (.Ok a)) :
    reserved = true ∧ a.weights.val = List.replicate 64 zeroK ∧
      a.rhs = zeroE ∧ a.power = oneK ∧ a.next = 0#usize := by
  change constructor reserved .S2 = ok (.Ok a) at accepted
  rw [constructor_shell] at accepted
  obtain ⟨weights,success,eq⟩ := (newS2_success _ a).mp accepted
  obtain ⟨reservedEq,contents⟩ := CheckpointBytes3Allocation.filled_success_content
    reserved 64#usize zeroK weights success
  subst a
  exact ⟨reservedEq,contents,rfl,rfl,rfl⟩

theorem allocation_rejects (base : Ops) :
    (install base false).op12 .S2 = ok (.Err AdapterRw.aspis_r1_cost_probe.verifier.Error.Allocation) := by
  change constructor false .S2 = _
  rw [constructor_shell,CheckpointBytes3Allocation.filled_rejection]
  rfl

/-- Same numerical decoder as checkpoint/query; no fresh representation is
introduced. The raw constant identities are proved, with no backend premise. -/
theorem accepted_initial (base : Ops) (reserved : Bool) (a : verifier.Accumulator)
    (accepted : (install base reserved).op12 .S2 = ok (.Ok a)) :
    CheckpointBytes5Output.accumulator a = QueryAccumulator.initial := by
  have kzero := Port3_Constants.decode_zero_k
  have kone := Port3_Constants.decode_one_k
  have ezero := Port3_Constants.decode_zero_e
  obtain ⟨_,weights,rhs,power,next⟩ := accepted_fields base reserved a accepted
  unfold CheckpointBytes5Output.accumulator QueryAccumulator.initial
  congr 1
  · funext j
    simp only [weights,List.getElem?_replicate,if_pos j.isLt,Option.getD_some,kzero]
  · rw [rhs,ezero]
  · rw [power,kone]
  · rw [next]; rfl

is pure and retains both allocation outcomes without inventing oracle calls. -/
theorem no_reads (reserved : Bool)
    (H : AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames.Bytes → AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep.State) :
    AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw.eval H
      (AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw.Program.done (constructor reserved .S2)) =
        ([],constructor reserved .S2) := rfl

/-! Library-model boundary for allocation and owned Vec operations. The
reservation result is retained, including Allocation failure. These are
content semantics: capacity, physical allocation and Drop are not modeled by
Aeneas Vec. A source adopter must identify the actual reservation outcome;
this module never asserts allocator success for all frozen inputs. -/

namespace AspisR1.OraclePortStdAllocation
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open OraclePortCkptAbi2Vec OraclePortCkptAbi3OwnedIter

inductive AllocationError where
  | allocation
  deriving DecidableEq

/-- Mutable Vec content and error are returned, rather than discarded. -/
def filled {T : Type} (n : Usize) (value : T) (reserved : Bool) :
    Result (Except AllocationError (alloc.vec.Vec T)) :=
  if reserved then do
    let v ← appendModel (alloc.vec.Vec.new T) (List.replicate n.val value)
    ok (.ok v)
  else ok (.error .allocation)

def filledSpec {T : Type} (n : Usize) (value : T) (reserved : Bool) :
    Result (Except AllocationError (alloc.vec.Vec T)) :=
  if reserved then ok (.ok ⟨List.replicate n.val value, by simp only [List.length_replicate]; scalar_tac⟩)
  else ok (.error .allocation)

theorem filled_exact {T : Type} (n : Usize) (value : T) (reserved : Bool) :
    filled n value reserved = filledSpec n value reserved := by
  cases reserved with
  | false => rfl
  | true =>
    unfold filled filledSpec
    simp only [↓reduceIte]
    have bound : (alloc.vec.Vec.new T).val.length +
        (List.replicate n.val value).length ≤ Usize.max := by
      change 0 + (List.replicate n.val value).length ≤ Usize.max
      simp only [List.length_replicate, Nat.zero_add]
      scalar_tac
    rw [append_exact _ _ bound]
    rfl

theorem filled_failure {T : Type} (n : Usize) (value : T) :
    filled n value false = ok (.error .allocation) := rfl

/-- Concrete declaration assignments, independent of the old owner labels. -/
def heapFilledSite : OraclePortJoinSplitStd.Site :=
  ⟨.trustedStd, "aspis_core::r0::heap::filled"⟩
def vecPushSite : OraclePortJoinSplitStd.Site :=
  ⟨.trustedStd, "alloc::vec::Vec::push"⟩
def vecAppendSite : OraclePortJoinSplitStd.Site :=

def ownedIterSite : OraclePortJoinSplitStd.Site :=
  ⟨.trustedStd, "alloc::vec::IntoIterator::into_iter/next"⟩
def fromFnSite : OraclePortJoinSplitStd.Site :=
  ⟨.trustedStd, "core::array::from_fn"⟩
def mapNextSite : OraclePortJoinSplitStd.Site :=
  ⟨.trustedStd, "core::iter::adapters::map::Map::next"⟩

def inventory : List OraclePortJoinSplitStd.Site :=
  [heapFilledSite, vecPushSite, vecAppendSite, ownedIterSite, fromFnSite, mapNextSite]

theorem inventory_std : ∀ s ∈ inventory, s.owner = .trustedStd := by
  intro s hs
  simp only [inventory, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hs
  rcases hs with h | h | h | h | h | h <;> subst s <;> rfl

/-- A concrete typed instance for the filled helper alone. Other declarations
are rejected, so the helper proof cannot grant trust to arbitrary std names. -/
def signature (T : Type) : OraclePortJoinSplitStd.Signature :=
  ⟨fun _ => Usize × T × Bool,
   fun _ => Result (Except AllocationError (alloc.vec.Vec T))⟩

def implementation (T : Type) : OraclePortJoinSplitStd.Implementation (signature T) :=
  fun site args => .done (if site = heapFilledSite then
    filled args.1 args.2.1 args.2.2 else .fail .panic)

def specification (T : Type) : OraclePortJoinSplitStd.Implementation (signature T) :=
  fun site args => .done (if site = heapFilledSite then
    filledSpec args.1 args.2.1 args.2.2 else .fail .panic)

theorem filled_cone_join (T : Type) : OraclePortJoinSplitStd.ConeJoin
    (implementation T) (specification T) .trustedStd := by
  intro site _ args
  simp only [implementation, specification, filled_exact]

/-- Coverage of the helper call includes both reservation outcomes, without
asserting that this one-call tree is the frozen verifier. -/
def helperTree {T : Type} (n : Usize) (value : T) (reserved : Bool) :
    OraclePortJoinSplitStd.Calls (signature T)
      (Result (Except AllocationError (alloc.vec.Vec T))) :=
  .invoke heapFilledSite (n,value,reserved) fun result => .done result

theorem helper_covered {T : Type} (n : Usize) (value : T) (reserved : Bool) :
    OraclePortJoinSplitStd.Covered inventory (helperTree n value reserved) := by
  exact ⟨by simp [inventory], fun _ => True.intro⟩

/-! Std/allocation extension of the substitution interface. No frozen implementation or caller tree is
constructed here. The source and model must share the *ordered* caller tree,
including rejection branches, repeated calls, all call arguments and reads.
S10 is coverage of its call sites, not an executable verifier stage. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.OraclePortJoinSplitStd
open FS FS2
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep
open AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw AspisV8R19.OracleProgramOps
open OraclePortStoredExperimentC4 OraclePortStoredConsumerC7 OraclePortRuntimeBindingC7

/-- Additive owner extension: the thirteen existing cone obligations remain. -/
inductive Cone where
  | owned (cone : OraclePortJoinSplit.Cone)
  | trustedStd
  deriving DecidableEq

structure Site where
  owner : Cone
  declaration : String
  deriving DecidableEq

/-- Arguments include the complete pre-state; values include the complete
post-state and ordinary Rust rejection. Hiding mutable state loses the join.
The instantiator must fix these carriers from the adopted source extraction. -/
structure Signature where
  Args : Site → Type
  Value : Site → Type

abbrev Implementation (σ : Signature) :=
  (site : Site) → σ.Args site → Program Bytes State (σ.Value site)

inductive Calls (σ : Signature) (α : Type) where
  | done (value : α)
  | invoke (site : Site) (args : σ.Args site) (next : σ.Value site → Calls σ α)
  | oracle (address : Bytes) (next : State → Calls σ α)

def interpret {σ : Signature} {α : Type} (impl : Implementation σ) :
    Calls σ α → Program Bytes State α
  | .done value => .done value
  | .invoke site args next => bind (impl site args) fun value => interpret impl (next value)
  | .oracle address next => .ask address fun value => interpret impl (next value)

/-- Total full-program equality: no acceptance, successful-call, canonicality
or oracle-world antecedent. Rejected inputs and read order are included. -/
def ConeJoin {σ : Signature} (source model : Implementation σ) (cone : Cone) : Prop :=
  ∀ site, site.owner = cone → ∀ args, source site args = model site args

structure PerConeJoins {σ : Signature} (source model : Implementation σ) : Prop where
  owned : ∀ c, ConeJoin source model (.owned c)
  trustedStd : ConeJoin source model .trustedStd

/-- S10 must cover *all* return continuations, including rejection paths.
Membership alone is not source pin validation: that remains P6/S10 evidence. -/
def Covered {σ : Signature} {α : Type} (inventory : List Site) : Calls σ α → Prop
  | .done _ => True
  | .invoke site _ next => site ∈ inventory ∧ ∀ value, Covered inventory (next value)
  | .oracle _ next => ∀ value, Covered inventory (next value)

def S10Join {σ : Signature} (inventory : List Site) (tree : Input → Calls σ Bool) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, Covered inventory (tree i)

theorem perCone_at {σ : Signature} {source model : Implementation σ}
    (joins : PerConeJoins source model) (site : Site) (args : σ.Args site) :
    source site args = model site args := by
  cases h : site.owner with
  | owned c => exact joins.owned c site h args
  | trustedStd => exact joins.trustedStd site h args

/-- Structural composition: branch-dependent continuations are preserved;
there is no permutation or acceptance-only extensionality step. -/
theorem interpret_eq {σ : Signature} {α : Type} {source model : Implementation σ}
    (joins : PerConeJoins source model) (tree : Calls σ α) :
    interpret source tree = interpret model tree := by
  induction tree with
  | done value => rfl
  | invoke site args next ih =>
      simp only [interpret, perCone_at joins site args]
      exact congrArg (bind (model site args)) (funext ih)
  | oracle address next ih =>
      exact congrArg (Program.ask address) (funext ih)

/-- These are the two independent caller proofs still owed: decompose the
actual frozen execution, and identify the fully substituted model with dV.
This is not a proof that a tree or either identity exists for frozen Rust. -/
structure CompositionOrderingJoin {σ : Signature} (D : LiteralByteProtocol.Decoder)
    (rust : Verifier) (source model : Implementation σ) (tree : Input → Calls σ Bool) : Prop where
  source_order : ∀ i, rust i = interpret source (tree i)
  model_order : ∀ i, interpret model (tree i) = verifier D dV i

theorem executionJoin_of_cones {σ : Signature} (D : LiteralByteProtocol.Decoder)
    (rust : Verifier) (source model : Implementation σ) (tree : Input → Calls σ Bool)
    (inventory : List Site) (h_cones : PerConeJoins source model)
    (_h_S10 : S10Join inventory tree)
    (h_order : CompositionOrderingJoin D rust source model tree) : ExecutionJoin D rust := by
  intro i
  exact (h_order.source_order i).trans ((interpret_eq h_cones (tree i)).trans
    (h_order.model_order i))

#print axioms perCone_at
#print axioms interpret_eq
#print axioms executionJoin_of_cones
end AspisR1.OraclePortJoinSplitStd

/-! A reified effect schedule with an ordered state interpreter. Pure Aeneas
operations retain failures/divergence; inner verifier errors are ordinary
values and retain the log. The state equations follow the D138 state lift.
Reification makes erasure a generic theorem, rather than a source hypothesis. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.CheckpointBytes5Effect
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1Stage2
abbrev Parts := Slice (Slice U8)
abbrev Digest := Array U8 32#usize
abbrev Log := List (Parts × Digest)
abbrev Port (S A : Type) := StateT S Result A

inductive Code (A : Type) : Type 1 where
  | done : A → Code A
  | step {B : Type} : Result B → (B → Code A) → Code A
  | read : Parts → (Digest → Code A) → Code A

def bind {A B : Type} : Code A → (A → Code B) → Code B
  | .done a, k => k a
  | .step r c, k => .step r (fun b => bind (c b) k)
  | .read parts c, k => .read parts (fun b => bind (c b) k)
instance : Monad Code where
  pure := Code.done
  bind := bind

def liftResult {A : Type} (r : Result A) : Code A := .step r .done
def read (parts : Parts) : Code Digest := .read parts .done

def erase {A H : Type} (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H) (hash : H) : Code A → Result A
  | .done a => ok a
  | .step r k => do let b ← r; erase D hash (k b)
  | .read parts k => do let b ← D.digest hash parts; erase D hash (k b)

def run {A H : Type} (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H) (hash : H) : Code A → Port Log A
  | .done a => fun log => ok (a,log)
  | .step r k => fun log => do let b ← r; run D hash (k b) log
  | .read parts k => fun log => do
      let b ← D.digest hash parts
      run D hash (k b) (log ++ [(parts,b)])

theorem bind_run {S A B : Type} (p : Port S A) (k : A → Port S B) (state : S) :
    (p >>= k) state = (do let (value,next) ← p state; k value next) := rfl

theorem erase_bind {A B H : Type} (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H) (hash : H)
    (p : Code A) (k : A → Code B) :
    erase D hash (p >>= k) = (do let a ← erase D hash p; erase D hash (k a)) := by
  induction p with
  | done a => rfl
  | step r c ih =>
    change (do let b ← r; erase D hash (bind (c b) k)) = _
    have h : ∀ b, erase D hash (bind (c b) k) =
      (do let a ← erase D hash (c b); erase D hash (k a)) := ih
    simp only [h,erase]
    cases r <;> rfl
  | read parts c ih =>
    change (do let b ← D.digest hash parts; erase D hash (bind (c b) k)) = _
    have h : ∀ b, erase D hash (bind (c b) k) =
      (do let a ← erase D hash (c b); erase D hash (k a)) := ih
    simp only [h,erase]
    cases D.digest hash parts <;> rfl

theorem erase_lift {A H : Type} (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H) (hash : H) (r : Result A) :
    erase D hash (liftResult r) = r := by cases r <;> rfl

theorem erase_read {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H) (hash : H) (p : Parts) :
    erase D hash (read p) = D.digest hash p := by
  simp only [read,erase]
  cases D.digest hash p <;> rfl

theorem erase_pure {A H : Type} (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H) (hash : H) (a : A) :
    erase D hash (pure a) = ok a := rfl

theorem run_success {A H : Type} (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H) (hash : H)
    (p : Code A) (before after : Log) (a : A)
    (success : run D hash p before = ok (a,after)) : erase D hash p = ok a := by
  induction p generalizing before after with
  | done b => exact congrArg (fun x => ok x.1) (Result.ok.inj success)
  | step r k ih =>
    cases r with
    | fail e => cases success
    | div => cases success
    | ok b => exact ih b before after success
  | read parts k ih =>
    cases call : D.digest hash parts with
    | fail e => simp only [run,call,bind_tc_fail] at success; cases success
    | div => simp only [run,call,bind_tc_div] at success; cases success
    | ok b =>
      simp only [run,call,bind_tc_ok] at success
      simpa only [erase,call,bind_tc_ok] using ih b _ _ success

theorem run_bind {A B H : Type} (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H) (hash : H)
    (p : Code A) (k : A → Code B) (log : Log) :
    run D hash (p >>= k) log =
      (do let (a,next) ← run D hash p log; run D hash (k a) next) := by
  induction p generalizing log with
  | done a => rfl
  | step r c ih =>
    change (do let b ← r; run D hash (bind (c b) k) log) = _
    have h : ∀ b log, run D hash (bind (c b) k) log =
      (do let (a,next) ← run D hash (c b) log; run D hash (k a) next) := ih
    simp only [h,run]
    cases r <;> rfl
  | read parts c ih =>
    change (do let b ← D.digest hash parts; run D hash (bind (c b) k) (log ++ [(parts,b)])) = _
    have h : ∀ b log, run D hash (bind (c b) k) log =
      (do let (a,next) ← run D hash (c b) log; run D hash (k a) next) := ih
    simp only [h,run]
    cases D.digest hash parts <;> rfl

theorem run_lift {A H : Type} (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H) (hash : H)
    (r : Result A) (log : Log) :
    run D hash (liftResult r) log = (do let a ← r; ok (a,log)) := rfl

theorem run_read {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H) (hash : H)
    (parts : Parts) (log : Log) :
    run D hash (read parts) log =
      (do let b ← D.digest hash parts; ok (b,log ++ [(parts,b)])) := rfl

theorem run_pure {A H : Type} (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H) (hash : H)
    (a : A) (log : Log) : run D hash (pure a) log = ok (a,log) := rfl

theorem erase_ite {A H : Type} (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H) (hash : H)
    (p : Prop) [Decidable p] (yes no : Code A) :
    erase D hash (if p then yes else no) =
      if p then erase D hash yes else erase D hash no := by split <;> rfl

theorem run_ite {A H : Type} (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H) (hash : H)
    (p : Prop) [Decidable p] (yes no : Code A) (log : Log) :
    run D hash (if p then yes else no) log =
      if p then run D hash yes log else run D hash no log := by split <;> rfl
